```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// London-krefter: elektronskyene svinger, og skyene i naboen svinger med (i motfase).
// To ting å justere: størrelsen på molekylene (antall kontakter) og avstanden mellom dem.
{
  const BLA = "#a9d0e6", BLAK = "#3d7ea6", ROD = "#e0584d", GRONN = "#3f8468";
  const uid = "lk" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
  const ANTALL = [2, 6];
  let n = ANTALL[0], W = 560, pause = false, t = 0, sist = null, snitt = 0;
  const st = new Array(6).fill(0); // forskyvning av skyen i øverste molekyl
  const sb = new Array(6).fill(0); // forskyvning av skyen i nederste molekyl
  const us = new Array(6).fill(0); // tiltrekning for hvert kontaktpar (0–1)
  const reduser = window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  const sD = Inputs.range([0, 1], { value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Avstand" });
  sD.querySelectorAll("input[type=number]").forEach((e) => (e.style.display = "none"));
  const chips = html`<div class="bk-chiprad"></div>`;
  const pauseKnapp = html`<button class="bk-chip" style="margin-left:auto">Pause</button>`;
  const bilde = html`<div></div>`;

  function geom() {
    const r = Math.max(14, Math.min(28, (W - 40) / (6 * 1.85)));
    const sp = 2 * r * 0.92;
    const dMin = 2 * r + 44, dMax = 2 * r + 120;
    const d = dMin + +sD.value * (dMax - dMin);
    const pad = 12;
    const yc = pad + r + dMax / 2; // molekylene flytter seg symmetrisk rundt midten
    return { r, sp, dMin, dMax, d, pad, x0: W / 2 - ((n - 1) * sp) / 2, y1: yc - d / 2, H: pad * 2 + 2 * r + dMax + 36 };
  }

  function steg(dt) {
    const g = geom(), A = 0.45 * g.r, f = g.dMin / g.d;
    t += dt;
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      st[i] = A * (0.55 * Math.sin(1.8 * t + 0.8 * i) + 0.45 * Math.sin(2.9 * t + 1.9 * i + 1));
      // skyen i naboen skyves motsatt vei, og mindre jo lenger unna den er
      sb[i] += (-(f ** 3) * st[i] - sb[i]) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.1));
      us[i] = Math.min(1, (st[i] / A) ** 2 * f ** 6);
      if (i < n) sum += us[i];
    }
    snitt += (sum / (6 * 0.28) - snitt) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.4));
  }

  function tegn() {
    const g = geom(), { r, sp, d, pad, x0, y1, H } = g, y2 = y1 + d;
    const kjerner = [], skyer = [], piler = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const cx = x0 + i * sp;
      for (const [cy, s] of [[y1, st[i]], [y2, sb[i]]]) {
        kjerner.push(`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r}" fill="${BLA}" stroke="${BLAK}" stroke-width="2"/>`);
        skyer.push(`<circle cx="${cx + s}" cy="${cy}" r="${r * 0.62}" fill="url(#${uid})"/>`);
      }
      const a = y1 + r + 3, b = y2 - r - 3, m = (a + b) / 2, u = us[i];
      const k = 6 + 4 * u, ty = 2 + 3 * u;
      piler.push(`<g stroke="${GRONN}" fill="${GRONN}" opacity="${0.3 + 0.7 * u}">
        <line x1="${cx}" y1="${a}" x2="${cx}" y2="${m - k + 1}" stroke-width="${ty}" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <polygon points="${cx - k * 0.7},${m - k} ${cx + k * 0.7},${m - k} ${cx},${m}" stroke="none"/>
        <line x1="${cx}" y1="${b}" x2="${cx}" y2="${m + k - 1}" stroke-width="${ty}" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <polygon points="${cx - k * 0.7},${m + k} ${cx + k * 0.7},${m + k} ${cx},${m}" stroke="none"/></g>`);
    }
    const my = H - 22, bx = pad + 92, bb = W - pad - bx, frak = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, snitt));
    bilde.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width:100%;max-width:${W}px;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto" role="img"
      aria-label="To molekyler oppå hverandre. Elektronskyene svinger, og tiltrekningen mellom molekylene vises som piler og en måler." font-family="inherit">
      <defs><radialGradient id="${uid}"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${ROD}" stop-opacity="1"/>
        <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="${ROD}" stop-opacity="0.85"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${ROD}" stop-opacity="0.15"/></radialGradient></defs>
      ${kjerner.join("")}${skyer.join("")}${piler.join("")}
      <text x="${pad}" y="${my}" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor">Tiltrekning</text>
      <rect x="${bx}" y="${my - 7}" width="${bb}" height="14" rx="7" fill="rgba(127,170,190,0.25)"/>
      <rect class="lk-maler" x="${bx}" y="${my - 7}" width="${Math.max(8, frak * bb)}" height="14" rx="7" fill="${GRONN}" data-verdi="${frak.toFixed(3)}"/></svg>`;
  }

  const merk = () => chips.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b, i) => { if (i < 2) b.classList.toggle("valgt", n === ANTALL[i]); });
  ["Lite molekyl", "Stort molekyl"].forEach((navn, i) => {
    const b = html`<button class="bk-chip">${navn}</button>`;
    b.onclick = () => { n = ANTALL[i]; merk(); tegn(); };
    chips.append(b);
  });
  chips.append(pauseKnapp);
  pauseKnapp.onclick = () => { pause = !pause; pauseKnapp.textContent = pause ? "Spill av" : "Pause"; if (pause) tegn(); };
  sD.addEventListener("input", () => { steg(0.0001); tegn(); });

  const rot = html`<div class="bk-aa-boks">${chips}${bilde}${sD}
    <p class="bk-hint">Rød: elektronskyen. Blå: kjernene. Her i sakte film.</p></div>`;

  merk();
  if (reduser) { pause = true; pauseKnapp.textContent = "Spill av"; for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) steg(0.05); }
  tegn();

  let anim, synlig = true;
  function lop(nå) {
    const dt = sist === null ? 0.016 : Math.min(0.05, (nå - sist) / 1000);
    sist = nå;
    if (synlig && !pause) { steg(dt); tegn(); }
    anim = requestAnimationFrame(lop);
  }
  anim = requestAnimationFrame(lop);
  const obs = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { synlig = e.isIntersecting; });
  obs.observe(rot);
  bkTilpass(rot, 640, (w) => { W = w; tegn(); }, invalidation);
  invalidation.then(() => { cancelAnimationFrame(anim); obs.disconnect(); });
  return rot;
}
```
